% A clean diagram: explicit sizes, framed nodes holding their own text,
% a 2 pt border and no background. Every audit check passes.
\documentclass[tikz,border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\fontsize{9}{10.8}\selectfont]
\node[draw, rounded corners, text width=2cm, align=center] (a) at (0,0) {Train every arm};
\node[draw, fill=blue!10, text width=2cm, align=center] (b) at (3.5,0) {Test};
\draw[-{Stealth}, line width=1.5pt] (a) -- (b);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
